facts.en: Completed a workplace numeracy course at Fictional Cottonreef Adult Centre in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构棉礁成人中心完成职场计算课程。

facts.en: Paid linen sorting assistant at Fictional Linenlark Laundry from 2021-06 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-06 至 2026-08 在虚构亚麻云雀洗衣厂任有薪床品分拣助理。

facts.en: Matched incoming customer-bag tags to route sheets and counted towels and sheets separately.
facts.zh: 将客户送洗袋标签与路线单匹配，并分别清点毛巾及床单。

facts.en: Sorted tagged linen using the shift lead’s supplied categories and set aside unidentified items for review.
facts.zh: 按班次负责人提供的类别分拣有标签床品，并将无法识别物品留待审核。

facts.en: Recorded visible damage before processing, using the customer code rather than guessing which room an item came from.
facts.zh: 在处理前记录可见损坏，使用客户代码，而非猜测物品来自哪个房间。

facts.en: Weighed incoming bags and recorded the supplied bag-tare value separately from linen mass.
facts.zh: 称量送洗袋，并将所提供的袋重扣除值与床品质量分开记录。

facts.en: A 2025-10-07 intake record showed 82 kg gross bagged mass and 4 kg total bag tare, giving 78 kg recorded linen mass for that intake.
facts.zh: 2025-10-07 的接收记录显示含袋毛质量为 82 千克，袋重扣除值合计 4 千克，该次接收记录的床品质量为 78 千克。

facts.en: That mass was recorded before washing; no clean-output mass or water-removal amount is included in the record.
facts.zh: 该质量记录于洗涤前；记录不含清洁后产出质量或除水量。

facts.en: Packed finished towels against customer-specific count sheets after the finishing team released them.
facts.zh: 在整理团队放行后，按客户专属计数表包装已整理毛巾。

facts.en: Compared packed counts with the route sheet and reported shortages before dispatch loading.
facts.zh: 将包装数量与路线单比较，并在装车发运前报告短缺。

facts.en: Helped trial larger customer-code tags on 3 collection routes in 2024-09.
facts.zh: 2024-09 协助在 3 条收取路线试用更大的客户代码标签。

facts.en: Personally checked tag readability at the sorting table; a route supervisor chose the final tag stock.
facts.zh: 个人在分拣台检查标签可读性；最终标签材料由路线主管选择。

facts.en: Uses tagged carts, platform scales, barcode scans and printed count sheets.
facts.zh: 使用带标签的推车、台秤、条码扫描及纸质计数表。

facts.en: Completed internal bag-handling and workflow induction in 2021-06.
facts.zh: 2021-06 完成内部洗衣袋搬运及工作流程入职培训。

facts.en: Attended a supervised flatwork-finisher familiarization session in 2025-02; the record contains no independent machine assignment afterward.
facts.zh: 2025-02 参加受监督的平烫机熟悉培训；记录中无此后独立操作该机器的任务。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Threadbasket Reuse Club from 2022-03 to 2023-12, sorting donated fabric by size for craft activities.
facts.zh: 2022-03 至 2023-12 在虚构线篮再利用社做志愿者，为手工活动按尺寸分拣捐赠布料。

facts.en: At that club, hand-sewed labels onto 16 reusable fabric storage bags designed by another volunteer.
facts.zh: 在该社为另一名志愿者设计的 16 个可重复使用布收纳袋手缝标签。

facts.en: Keeps a personal notebook of patchwork colour combinations with no commercial textile-treatment claims.
facts.zh: 保留个人拼布配色笔记，不涉及商业纺织处理声称。

facts.en: Enjoys taking close-up photographs of woven textures.
facts.zh: 爱好拍摄编织纹理特写。

facts.en: Provided an end-of-shift cart-location list to the incoming sorting team.
facts.zh: 向接班分拣团队提供班末推车位置清单。
